name: Our Security, Our Rights: National Security Green Paper, 2016
description: Government of Canada consultation paper examining 10 areas of national security law and policy (including accountability, information sharing, cyber security, and intelligence oversight) prior to the introduction of the National Security Act, 2017 (Bill C-59).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cyber resilience, critical infrastructure protection, and government-wide incident coordination relevant to cloud service providers operating in Canada.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses emerging digital technology threats, supply-chain security, and national security governance applicable to AI systems.
